USB restriction vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM USB restriction marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate accessory and external storage policy — not a literal paste of US marketing:

USB 限制 (USB restrictions)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses USB 限制 when describing MDM-configured allow or deny policy for USB device connections on enrolled fleet Macs and, where applicable, iOS and iPadOS endpoints. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a restriction toggle frame needs USB 限制-friendly headlines; a technical badge may keep USB restrictions in English when accurate to your English source.

配件限制 (accessory restrictions)

When MDM workflows restrict USB accessories, Lightning or USB-C peripherals, and connected device classes, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 配件限制 or 配件管理. Use when your gallery shows accessory allow or deny lists, peripheral policy editors, or "Accessory restrictions" overlays — distinct from Configurator 配置器 USB prep vocabulary.

外置存储 (external storage)

MDM platforms may allow or deny external storage media — USB flash drives, external disks, and removable storage on Mac endpoints. zh-Hans marketing uses 外置存储 when your English source genuinely markets external storage allow or deny policy — not generic "secure every file instantly" overclaims your screenshots do not support.

USB 设备策略 (USB device policy)

When marketing frames emphasize fleet-wide USB device governance, USB 设备策略 may appear alongside USB 限制. AppLocale aligns with whether your UX leads with allow lists, deny lists, or compliance dashboards for peripheral connections.

允许或拒绝 USB 设备 (allow or deny USB devices)

Admin-console frames that show explicit allow or deny toggles for USB connections map to concise zh-Hans benefit lines for 允许 USB 设备 and 拒绝 USB 设备 — aligned with whether your UX leads with permissive allow lists or restrictive deny lists on fleet endpoints.
